Class FabricNetworkTransport

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.network.fabric.FabricNetworkTransport

  • Field Details

    • HANDSHAKE

      public static final net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation HANDSHAKE
      Login-query channel the server asks about before the player joins. A client that answers it has the mod and replies with its network version; one that does not understand it, or runs another version, is refused.
